All prior functionality must remain working. Coordinate reference for this stage: logical pixel coordinates have a top-left origin. Convert every vertex exactly once to clip coordinates: clipX = 2*x/logicalWidth - 1; clipY = 1 - 2*y/logicalHeight. Pass the actual state.config.width and height when using helpers, or perform this conversion explicitly in the vertex shader. Vertex counts are counts of vertices: two floats per XY position means length/2; use the complete stride for interleaved attributes. The ready scene also draws the bird and enough details for at least four distinguishable colors. If a real browser color check fails, inspect finite vertex values, conversion, attribute stride and draw count. Fix your geometry rather than modifying browser prototypes, getContext or readPixels. Keep real WebGL drawing and all lifecycle requirements.
